title: Unnamed Southern California facility storing non-human bodies

tellings.quote: >> Yeah. A place out in California. Oh, an unnamed place. A place that doesn't have its own designation.
hey the bodies are st stored over there in California
tellings.link_reason: Both are the same teller's claim that non-human bodies are stored at an unnamed place in California.

plain: The researcher UAPGerb says on Jesse Michels' podcast that an unnamed source told him non-human bodies are being stored at a place in California. He describes it as a site with no official name or designation of its own, and at one point says only "California" rather than Southern California. If true, it would mean the government is quietly holding the remains of beings that are not human.
